1879213906.desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879214930.desc: A basic sigil which burns your foe over a brief time.\n\nIf this skill is used whilst your companion flanks the enemy, your Power will be restored and your fire will burn hotter for a time.

1879221714.name: Steed of the Horse-lords
1879221714.desc: A pony meant for carrying an adventurer wherever they may roam.

1879238610.desc: Crying out, you encourage your steed to continue the fight and restore a moderate amount of its endurance in the process.

1879243986.name: Rally the Riders
1879243986.desc: You issue a fearsome call to arms that negatively affects enemies surrounding you while bolstering allies around you.

1879248338.desc: Your music culminates in a great Anthem that brings forth the wrath of Rohan, the Red Dawn.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Alters Coda: instantly restores power to you and nearby fellowship members and war-steeds.</rgb>

1879316050.name: Ferocious Roar

1879378514.name: Steed from the White Wizard's Tower

1879423442.name: Hurl Object
